verdict.rationale: ZCode's claimed docs describe Goal mode, which keeps planning, executing and verifying multi-step work (zcode-docs-2). They also describe remotely waking ZCode via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram to start tasks (zcode-docs-3), which is a human-initiated trigger rather than true always-on automation. Nothing in the pack shows scheduled runs, event triggers, or agents that autonomously maintain and fix code without a person prompting them. Missing for 10: scheduled/cron agent runs, event-driven triggers (e.g. CI failures, issues, commits), always-on background agent documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
